cases.why: SYNTHETIC — no real reminder SMS captured yet. Shape derived from the #107 research (docs/BANK_COVERAGE.md §7.2): a registered sender's repayment reminder moved money today, because «پرداخت» sits inside «بازپرداخت» and matched OUT_WORDS, so the «مبلغ» line became a 4,000,000 ریال withdrawal, and the «مانده» line anchored the account. It is a notice about a loan, not a payment from the account.

SYNTHETIC — no real welcome SMS captured yet. A registration greeting that restates the opening balance is not the bank saying what the account holds now; read today it anchored the balance on the strength of a message nobody meant as a statement.

SYNTHETIC — the second-factor shape, not a captured message. The one-time-password rule only declines a «رمز» message when it states no «مانده», so a dynamic-password prompt carrying both a مبلغ and a مانده was read as a transaction at low confidence and anchored the balance. The code is not a movement.

SYNTHETIC — a credit-line expiry notice, not a captured message. «اعتبار تا» announces how long a credit lasts; the مبلغ beside it is not money leaving the account, but today it read as a figure on the movement path and the مانده anchored.

SYNTHETIC — the other side of the guard. A real receipt prints a «کد پیگیری», and the competitor's blanket «کد » rule would decline every one of them. The guard is deliberately narrow: only «کد تایید» is a notice, and this genuine withdrawal must still be read, with its tracking number kept as the reference.
